textHelp.title: WFSTCONTROLS
textHelp.paragraph1: This plugin groups transactional editing actions on a WFS layer loaded in the map: draw, modify or delete features, edit attributes, clear local changes and save to the service (depending on configured controls). It requires a compatible WFS layer and, if needed, a geometry parameter or automatic geometry detection.
textHelp.screenshot1Alt: Icon of wfstcontrols in the map
textHelp.screenshot2Alt: Panel detail with draw, modify, save and other editing actions
textHelp.screenshot2Description: Use draw or modify on the map, edit attributes if enabled, click Save to send changes to the service or Clear to discard unsaved local edits.
